not_claimed: Natural-language fact acquisition from the controlled descriptions
Lexical truth of explicit source claims

contract.raw_source_identity: Exact UTF-8 byte spans and preserved source bytes; adapters use valid lowercase transport identifiers.
contract.lexical_linkage: Exact UTF-8 surface, no Unicode normalization or mark stripping; all matching independent readings retained.
contract.pronouns: Declared new Unicode projection of the canonical Mashru 14 readings; input marks are subsets of canonical cluster marks; no hamza folding.
contract.nominal_profiles: 22 complete noun profiles: singular, dual, sound masculine plural, sound feminine plural, broken plural, other plural; two genders and two definiteness values; feminine sound masculine profiles excluded; masculine sound feminine profiles allowed.
contract.plural_origin: Declared plural kind can constrain the source-qualified form; an origin link independently requires a unique same-source singular reading with licensed gender.
contract.manqus_correction: Before gold freeze, add explicit non-geminated/geminated ya source clauses. Raw final-ya shadda is negative observed evidence; absence of a mark is not positive unshaddad evidence.
contract.weak_root: Exactly three canonical Arabic radicals; only waw and ya count as weak; alif, alif maqsura and seated/decomposed hamza are not silently folded. Classification is conditional on supplied radicals.
contract.count_rule_domain: Strict int 1..99, 100 or 1000; singular gender masculine/feminine; rule requirements are distinct from actual case/role.
contract.counted_gender: The singular noun reading or a unique licensed singular-base link; plural-surface agreement gender does not substitute.
contract.digits: ASCII and Arabic-Indic cardinal digits express value but no observed numeral gender.
contract.count_source_units: Distinct Arabic written runs including quoted child mentions, excluding non-Arabic runs; context and original spans retained.
contract.verify_sentinel: Omitted lexical_text replays embedded premises; explicit None withdraws them and must invalidate an old premise-dependent report.

common_invariants: Raw source and every witness span restore the original UTF-8 bytes.
Different source occurrences and reading identities cannot share authority accidentally.
No report establishes world-object count, actual case, actual role or external lexical truth.
A complete supported numeric rule is a requirement, not an observation of its realization.
Missing facts are unknown; unsupported qualifiers cannot be silently dropped.
Contradictions within a reading remain distinct from multiple alternative readings.
A given root is an operand or explicit source claim, never a root discovered by raw shape alone.
Source-qualified explicit class extraction has its own denominator and is not counted as unprompted lexical acquisition.

expectation_semantics.axes: Semantic candidates, independent of eventual output field names; form names are reader-facing abstract labels.
expectation_semantics.forbid_licensed_axes: An observation may exist, but no singleton licensed conclusion may be activated for these axes.
expectation_semantics.manqus_not_true: No activated true manqus conclusion; an independently witnessed false conclusion is allowed.
expectation_semantics.has_conflict: A relevant incompatible source/observation constraint must be reported; the adapter may map its explicit scoped status.
expectation_semantics.no_nominal_classification: Unsupported or insufficient source premises cannot activate nominal trait conclusions.
expectation_semantics.must_reject: Input is outside the typed operand contract and must not return a successful class/rule.
expectation_semantics.no_supported_rule: Reject or explicitly defer/out-of-domain without a licensed nearby rule; no silent coercion.
expectation_semantics.no_complete_supported_relation: Do not report a fully supported bounded count-noun relation by discarding unparsed text.
expectation_semantics.number_rule_case: Expected case requirement only; contextual means no fixed required case for one/two.
